attributes.board_name: Ohio Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy, and Athletic Trainers Board – Occupational Therapy Section

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities sponsored/approved by the OT Section, OOTA, AOTA, NBCOT or AOTA-approved providers, or meeting the rule's criteria: workshops, seminars, conferences (no limit); presenting (2 h per hour, max 8); preparing a new ACOTE course (max 8); publications (article 5, book 10, chapter 5, film 10); college courses (max 10 per course); fieldwork supervision (Level I 1 per student, Level II 6 per 8 weeks / 9 per 12 weeks; max 16); self-study and interactive distance learning (no limit); apprenticeships (5 h per 40-h week); research (max 10); informal study of articles; Ohio jurisprudence exam (1 h, once per cycle); mentorship (max 4).
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: The OT Section audits at least 5% of license holders each renewal year; audited licensees submit all records by the deadline; no response leads to disciplinary action.

topics.who: Ethics, jurisprudence, or cultural competence (passing the Ohio OT jurisprudence exam counts); cannot double-count with the mental health/substance use hour

rules.notes: Also required: at least 1 contact hour of mental health and/or substance use education per cycle (no matching topic code). Hours must be earned in the 2 years before June 30 of the renewal year; OT licenses renew June 30 of odd-numbered years.
